legal_source.doc: Instruction No. 2773 (06.04.2016) on filling the BYD/GTD

grafas.format: free text, e-GTD separate fields + upper-right code after № + bottom: № TIN/PINFL / district code
grafas.rule_en: Consignor AND exporter (Uzbek side). Same person: individual – full name, permanent address, phone; legal entity – short name, legal address, phone, e-mail (if any). A branch acting for the exporter: branch details, then the legal entity's details. Different persons (consignor ships on the exporter's instruction): consignor name, address, phone, then 'по поручению' + exporter name and address; if grafa 9 already shows the exporter, it need not be repeated here. Upper-right after '№': 00000001 resident individual, 00000002 non-resident individual, 00000003 organisation with state share, 99999999 diplomatic/consular, 88888888 international/government organisation offices, otherwise empty. Bottom after '№': consignor TIN (PINFL for an individual; branch TIN if a branch acts) '/' district (city) code per Annex 15 by legal address; no TIN/PINFL → 999999999. Not filled on additional paper sheets.
grafas.example: «PAXTA TEKS» MChJ (SYNTHETIC), Ташкентская обл., Ташкентский р-н, ул. Навои 1, тел. +998 71 000 00 00 | № 100000009/1727265

vs_im40.difference: IM40 grafa 2 = FOREIGN consignor (no TIN/district). In EK10 grafa 2 is the UZBEK consignor/exporter with the upper-right status code and the bottom TIN/PINFL + district code (those fields sit in grafa 8 for IM40).

grafas.format: free text; e-GTD separate fields per party
grafas.rule_en: Person named as consignee in the transport documents (foreign buyer side): individual – full name, residence (country short name per Annex 5 + address); legal entity – short name and location (country short name + address). If the consignee receives on behalf of another person: consignee first, then 'по поручению' + that person. E-GTD: consignee, the person on whose behalf it receives (the contract party with the grafa-9 person) and other persons from the accompanying documents each in its own field. Not filled on additional paper sheets.

grafas.format: left: "<count> <TRANSPORT>: plate[/trailer]; ..."; right: country code; e-GTD extra fields
grafas.rule_en: Vehicle(s) on which the goods are loaded for delivery to the border crossing point (or, if transhipped before the border, to the transhipment place). Left: number of vehicles, space, short transport name (Annex 6), colon, identifiers separated by ';' (vessel name, flight, wagon no., plate …); road trains: trailers after '/'. Right: numeric country code of the vehicle (of the tractor unit for road trains); several countries → '999' (paper: 'см. на обороте'; e-GTD: no reference, all data in fields). Pipeline / power line: 'ТРУБОПРОВОД' / 'ЛЭП'. Additionally (e-GTD separate fields): gross kg of goods in the vehicle; 2-digit vehicle type code (10 car ≤8 seats, 21 truck ≤10 t, 22 truck 10–20 t, 23 truck >20 t, 31/32/33 buses by seats, 40 minibus, 50 tractor, 60 motorcycle, 70 special); VIN; numeric code of the country where carriage ends; carrier (individual: full name, PINFL, passport series/no.; legal entity: name, TIN) and driver (full name, PINFL, passport). Non-resident carrier/driver without TIN/PINFL → '99999999999999'.
grafas.example: 1 АВТО: 10A123BC/10XY456 | 860; extra: 18450.000 кг; 23; VIN XTC00000000000000; 398; carrier «TRANS YO'L» MChJ (SYNTHETIC) TIN 100000010; driver Rahimov Bobur (SYNTHETIC), PINFL 30000000000000, AA0000000
cross_checks: gross in vehicle ≥ Σ grafa 35 of this GTD
grafas.uncertain: The vehicle-type code list in the text read ends at '70'; check ed2 for further codes ⚠️.

vs_im40.difference: IM40 grafa 18 = vehicle that carried the goods inside Uzbekistan to the clearing post, without the extra carrier/driver/VIN/vehicle-type fields. EK10 adds gross-in-vehicle, vehicle type code, VIN, end-of-carriage country, carrier and driver identity (sub-point 14 as amended by 2773-9, 2023).

legal_source.doc: Instruction No. 2773 (06.04.2016) on filling the BYD/GTD

grafas.format: 3 subfields: [numeric Incoterms code] [letter code + place] [settlement form/dispatch form]
grafas.rule_en: 1st: numeric delivery-terms code (Annex 7). 2nd: letter code + geographic place. 3rd (per contract): 2-digit settlement form, '/', 2-digit dispatch form (separate e-GTD fields). Settlement form: 10 prepayment; 20 letter of credit; 30 bank guarantee; 40 export-contract insurance policy (political & commercial risks); 50 payment after export; 60 consignment; 70 barter; 80 free-of-charge. Mixed forms → the one with the largest absolute amount. Dispatch form: 01 goods sent directly to the contract party; 02 not sent directly to the contract party. Gratuitous supplies: terms from accompanying documents.
cross_checks: settlement form consistent with contract payment terms

vs_im40.difference: EK10-only third subfield: settlement-form code + dispatch-form code. IM40 grafa 20 has no such subfield.

grafas.name_uz_cyrl: Юк жойлари ва товар тавсифи / Маркировка ва миқдор — контейнерлар рақами — товар тавсифи
grafas.name_uz_latn: Yuk joylari va tovar tavsifi / Markirovka va miqdor — konteynerlar raqami — tovar tavsifi
grafas.name_ru: Грузовые места и описание товара / Маркировка и количество — номера контейнеров — описание товара
grafas.format: numbered lines 1–5 + bottom-left producer TIN/district + bottom-right supplementary quantity
grafas.rule_en: Description sufficient for unambiguous 10-digit classification; each element on a new numbered line. 1: trade name, trademark/brand, model, article, grade, standards, technical and commercial characteristics, composition (e-GTD: brand in separate field; 'без марки'/'без бренда' if none); parameters in other units and production date if needed for payments or prohibitions/restrictions. The generic heading text of the TN VED is not allowed. 2: packages – number of packages, packing type and number of packings ('часть коробки' if not whole); bulk: 01 насыпью, 02 навалом, 03 наливом; not filled for pipeline/power line. 3: container numbers ('часть' if partly). 4: excise stamps – series, numbers (ranges with hyphen) and quantity. 5: pipeline/power line: 'Поставка в период с … по …'. Bottom-left (separate field): TIN (PINFL) of the PRODUCER (manufacturer/grower) '/' district code (Annex 15) by legal address; for HS 07, 08, 0904, 1202, 1008, 1207409000, 2008191900 the district where the produce was GROWN per the phytosanitary certificate – one item per district if several. Producer unknown or several producers → consignor's TIN (PINFL) and territory code. Bottom-right: quantity in supplementary unit + symbol (code in grafa 41; e-GTD quantity only); 2 decimals, <0.01 → 6 decimals; kg-only codes → empty.

1) Футболка мужская трикотажная, 100% хлопок, модель PT-01, бренд PAXTA TEKS
2) 200 мест, картонные коробки
 | 100000009/1727265 | 4000 шт

grafas.format: one document per line: "<code> <short> № ... от DD.MM.YYYY"
grafas.rule_en: Documents for each item with Annex-12 code (each on a new line): a) licence (101 ЛИЦЕНЗИЯ … срок); b) transport and commercial documents (e.g. 202 СМР, 205 АВИА, 220 ИНВ); c) contract (301 КНТ) and the transport contract with a non-resident carrier + its e-system ID; d) permits/certificates of other authorities (417 ССТ, 419 ФТСС phytosanitary …); e) registration of the contract / individual-entrepreneur certificate (501, 502); f) benefit: '6' + payment code (Annex 13) + Annex-14 act code (empty if no exemption or no rate); g) certificate of origin – export example 702 СПТЭК; h) other documents (deferral, commission/pledge contract, fine decision or 'form-2', etc.).

legal_source.doc: Instruction No. 2773 (06.04.2016) on filling the BYD/GTD

grafas.format: table rows: Вид | Основа начисления | Ставка | Сумма | СП
grafas.rule_en: Per item and per payment type; the clearance fee always on the main sheet / item 1. 'Вид' = Annex 13 code – for export typically 10 (clearance fee); 25 export customs duty and 28 excise on exported goods only where a rate is set. 'Основа' in UZS (grafa 12/45 at CBU rate on acceptance date) unless set in foreign currency or non-money units. 'Ставка' = applied rate. 'Сумма' in UZS (or foreign currency if law requires). 'СП' codes as IM40 (БН, КТ, … ОП deferral, РП instalments, ВЗ VAT offset, ОО no payment). No row if no rate, zero rate, or the regime creates no obligation.
grafas.uncertain: Export clearance fee band/amount not re-checked here – use data/tariff/fees.json and confirm it applies to export ⚠️.

vs_im40.difference: Same columns/СП codes. Payment codes differ: import duty 20/21, import excise 27 and VAT 29 do not arise for export; export duty 25 / export excise 28 only where rates exist (Annex 13: https://lex.uz/docs/2924953#8356110).

Non-resident without PINFL → 14 nines. If an authorised person: number, date and validity of the contract/power of attorney.

E-GTD authenticity is certified by the declaring person's ЭЦП (ERI).

changed.difference: Direction 'ЭК' instead of 'ИМ'; regime 10 instead of 40.

IM40 grafa 2 = FOREIGN consignor (no TIN/district). In EK10 grafa 2 is the UZBEK consignor/exporter with the upper-right status code and the bottom TIN/PINFL + district code (those fields sit in grafa 8 for IM40).

IM40 grafa 8 = Uzbek importer with status code and TIN/district. EK10 grafa 8 = FOREIGN consignee: name + country + address only – the text read has NO TIN/district bottom part and no upper-right status code.

IM40 grafa 18 = vehicle that carried the goods inside Uzbekistan to the clearing post, without the extra carrier/driver/VIN/vehicle-type fields. EK10 adds gross-in-vehicle, vehicle type code, VIN, end-of-carriage country, carrier and driver identity (sub-point 14 as amended by 2773-9, 2023).
EK10-only third subfield: settlement-form code + dispatch-form code. IM40 grafa 20 has no such subfield.
IM40: code of the grafa-21 vehicle that DID cross (not filled for change of regime). EK10 has no grafa 21; grafa 25 is the planned border-crossing vehicle type.
IM40: entry post (already crossed). EK10: planned exit post.

IM40 grafa 31 has lines 1–11 (incl. energy-efficiency class etc.) and the bottom-left shows the importer/consumer side. EK10: lines 1–5; bottom-left = PRODUCER TIN/district (growing district for listed agri codes).
Starts with 10 instead of 40. The IM40 text's remark that customs transit counts as 'no previous regime' is not repeated in point 22 (sub-point 32).

IM40 grafa 40 almost always holds the transit document (ТД …) or delivery-control book (ККДГ/МДП). EK10 grafa 40 only refers to a previous GTD; for goods produced in Uzbekistan it stays empty (our reading).
Same box, different meaning: IM40 '1' = imported for own needs / '0' = not for own needs. EK10 '1' = exporter is the manufacturer / '0' = not the manufacturer.

Same lettered structure a)–h) as IM40; export-specific examples: 702 СПТЭК (export certificate of origin) instead of 701 СПТИМ, 419 ФТСС phytosanitary certificate. Code 904 МЕТОД: see grafa-map.json (IM40) note – not mentioned for EK10 either ⚠️.
Same format; for export the Customs Code rules for EXPORTED goods apply – our pointer: Arts. 315–317 (https://lex.uz/docs/2876354), not the import methods 302–313.

Same columns/СП codes. Payment codes differ: import duty 20/21, import excise 27 and VAT 29 do not arise for export; export duty 25 / export excise 28 only where rates exist (Annex 13: https://lex.uz/docs/2924953#8356110).
IM40 grafa C has a 2nd line (date of import = border stamp date). EK10 has only line 1.

not_filled_by_declarant_for_ek10: Every grafa not in the point-21 list (e.g. 4, 6, 10, 15, 15a, 16, 21, 27, 36, 51–53) is not filled by the declaring person for EK10.

customs_only.rule: 99999/DD.MM.YYYY/9999999 – post code / acceptance date / serial number of the post's GTDs in the year
paper additional sheets only: registration number from grafa 7
e-GTD only: per payment code, total amount over all items; exemptions shown with 'без оплаты'
customs decision marks; filling grafa D completes clearance (point 13)
